boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten recurring Manhattan University celebrations and community practices documented by the University.

cards.title: Manhattan University Day of Service
cards.subtitle: Campus service across the Bronx
cards.notes: Join a volunteer project through the campus-wide service day; past work has included park cleanup, food distribution, and serving seniors.
cards.short_summary: A University-wide day of Bronx-focused volunteer work.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University invites its entire campus to participate in its Day of Service through volunteer projects for Bronx organizations.
cards.access_notes: Consult the University events calendar for the current date, project choices, and registration details.

cards.title: Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: September campus gathering
cards.notes: Invite family to the September weekend and check the current program for campus activities, the Yankees outing, and the Chapel Mass.
cards.short_summary: A September weekend that brings Jasper families to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University describes Family Weekend as a September, three-day campus event with activities, a Yankees game, and a special Chapel Mass.
cards.access_notes: Check the current Family Weekend schedule before making plans; individual activities may have separate arrangements.

cards.title: Festival of Lessons & Carols
cards.subtitle: Chapel of De La Salle and His Brothers
cards.notes: Attend the early-December Chapel service for readings, orchestra performances, choral singing, and its concluding candlelit prayer.
cards.short_summary: A December Chapel service combining readings, music, and candlelight.
cards.evidence_claim: The University calls Lessons and Carols a Christmas tradition held in early December, featuring scripture, orchestra, chorals, and a candlelit prayer.
cards.access_notes: The University advises arriving early; confirm the service date and attendance information through its events calendar.

cards.title: Jasper Day of Wellness
cards.subtitle: Spring-semester, no-class day
cards.notes: Use the no-class wellness day to try campus activities such as fitness sessions, wellness walks, cooking, dance, or community cleanup.
cards.short_summary: A spring no-class day centered on mental and physical health.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University says Jasper Day of Wellness is a spring-semester full day with no classes and activities focused on mental and physical health.
cards.access_notes: Activity offerings vary; look to the University calendar for the current program.

cards.title: Jasper Jingle
cards.subtitle: End-of-semester holiday dinner-dance
cards.notes: Mark the end of the fall term at this off-campus formal dinner-dance; follow Student Engagement announcements for logistics.
cards.short_summary: A formal holiday dinner-dance before finals.
cards.evidence_claim: The University identifies Jasper Jingle as an off-campus formal dinner-dance celebrating the Christmas season and end of the semester.
cards.access_notes: The location and attendance arrangements are announced for each year; verify them before attending.

cards.title: Latinx Fest
cards.subtitle: Great Room, Raymond W. Kelly Student Commons
cards.notes: Join the Hispanic Heritage Month finale in the Great Room for food, music, dancing, and a student-facing celebration of Latino culture.
cards.short_summary: A campus celebration that closes Hispanic Heritage Month.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University states that Latinx Fest is open to all students and caps off Hispanic Heritage Month with food, music, and dancing.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current date, entry details, and program through the University events calendar.

cards.title: Senior Week & Commencement
cards.subtitle: Graduation-season program
cards.notes: Eligible seniors can review the annual package and schedule for the formal, Gaelic Park event, honors convocation, and off-campus outing.
cards.short_summary: A graduation-week sequence of senior events and ceremonies.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University lists Senior Week activities including a Senior Formal, an outdoor party at Gaelic Park, Spring Honors Convocation, and an off-campus event.
cards.access_notes: Senior Week offerings and eligibility change by year; consult the graduation and Student Engagement announcements.

cards.title: Spring Concert
cards.subtitle: Draddy Gymnasium and the Quad
cards.notes: Follow the spring announcement for the concert, then plan for the associated barbecue and carnival activities on the Quad.
cards.short_summary: A campus spring concert paired with Quad festivities.
cards.evidence_claim: The University describes Spring Concert as a campus event with a concert in Draddy Gymnasium plus a barbecue and carnival on the Quad.
cards.access_notes: Artist, date, entry requirements, and activities are announced separately each year.

cards.entity_name: Manhattan University St. Patrick's Day Parade March
cards.title: March with the Jaspers on Fifth Avenue
cards.subtitle: Manhattan University Gaelic Society and Pipes and Drums
cards.notes: If you are a Manhattan student, watch for march details and join the Gaelic Society and Pipes and Drums contingent on Fifth Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A student march in New York City's St. Patrick's Day Parade.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University invites all its students to march in the St. Patrick's Day Parade alongside the Gaelic Society and Pipes and Drums band.
cards.access_notes: Confirm University sign-up, meeting point, and parade-day guidance before participating.

cards.title: The Brother Jasper Seventh-Inning Stretch
cards.subtitle: Manhattan baseball tradition with a disputed wider origin
cards.notes: At a Jasper game, take the seventh-inning pause as a campus-history moment; the University credits Brother Jasper with directing students to stretch.
cards.short_summary: A Manhattan baseball story tied to the enduring Jaspers identity.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University Athletics says Brother Jasper had students stand and stretch during a seventh inning and that the Manhattan practice spread to the major leagues.
cards.access_notes: This is a historical attribution presented by University Athletics; it is not an instruction to attend a particular event.
